opportunities.name: Plan a city weekend trip and email the plan to a friend
opportunities.description: For a given city, dates, party size, two activities, cuisine and recipient: look up the city on Wikipedia, check its weather on timeanddate, find a hotel on Booking, find two activities on Viator, find a dinner restaurant on OpenTable-style site (co), save a summary note, and draft an email with the plan.
opportunities.site: wikipedia.org, timeanddate.com, booking.com, viator.com, restaurant booking site (co), notes app, mail app
steps: On Wikipedia, search for {city} and open the city article; record the population
On timeanddate, search for {city} and open its Weather page; record the current temperature
On Booking.com, set destination to {city}, select check-in {checkin_date} and check-out {checkout_date}, set travelers to {party_size} adults, click Search
Open the chosen hotel result and record its name and total price
On Viator, search '{activity_1} {city}' and open the chosen tour; record its title
On Viator, search '{activity_2} {city}' and open the chosen tour; record its title
On the restaurant site, search '{city} {cuisine}', pick {checkin_date} in the date selector, set party size to {party_size}, click Find a table / Let's go
Open the chosen restaurant's details and record its name and a 19:30 slot
In Notes, create a new note: '{city} {dates}: pop {population}, {temp}, hotel {hotel} €{price}, {activity_1_title}, {activity_2_title}, dinner {restaurant} 19:30'

In Mail, compose to {recipient_email}, subject '{city} weekend {dates}', body 'Hi {name}, plan: hotel {hotel} (€{price}), {activity_1} and {activity_2}, dinner at {restaurant} ({cuisine}) on {checkin_date}.'
Save/send or discard the draft as appropriate
